Recommended the re-appointment of Mr. Devadas Alva (DIN: 06902537) as a Non- Ex-ecutive Director liable to retire by rotation.6. Appointment of M/s JSK & Co., (Firm Regn no- 159727W) as the Internal Auditors of the Company for FY 2026-2027.
